Admitted families: small-displacement homogeneous-isotropic straight circular pipe members (shear deformation as the contract declares: euler_bernoulli, or timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1 with the energy-matched annular shear factor, whose nodal rotations are section rotations; G is derived from E/nu) and linear restraints or springs; realized curved bends are Euler-Bernoulli under either shear model and, with expansion joints authored as objective connectors, are admitted only as the bend and connector limitations state. Section bases: stiffness and pipe metal mass use the nominal wall; contents mass and pressure end-cap areas use the reduced bore; every stress row is published on the nominal section and on the reduced section (wall minus mill tolerance and corrosion allowance) and names its basis, and each basis has its own maximum and headline; no governing basis is chosen. Each basis's Lamé stresses are those of its own annulus, while the axial membrane stress divides the one wall force by that basis's area. Every other component, support, combination or equivalent-static family is refused by name (EXACT_PRESSURE_FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED) until a later contract revision admits it.

Pressure is a signed internal differential with zero external pressure increment, uniform within each explicit case-scoped collinear equal-bore region with explicit closure-transfer paths. A negative differential is admitted, but external-pressure stability and collapse are not assessed.
Not modelled: steady-flow momentum and transient pressure loads; bend opening under pressure (Bourdon effect); pressure stiffening of flexibility factors and stress intensification; ovalization.
Mechanical, pressure-eigen and cap-transfer contributions remain distinct; rounded cap/eigen ledgers are observational and do not replace source-grouped pressure assembly.
Structural line loads act as entered; contents density does not imply hydrostatic pressure head or a coupled static-fluid pressure/weight state.
Signed support actions are attributed only for admitted linear restraints and springs; ambiguous coincident rigid attribution is refused.
The circular normal-stress maximum bounds the supplied binary64 polynomial coefficient enclosures; solution error is separate, and incomplete coverage withholds the headline.

Every member section declares its corrosion allowance and the contract declares its shear model. This envelope publishes ordinary structural recovery. Retained-source recovery is available only for euler_bernoulli documents with zero mill tolerance and zero corrosion allowance, and only for straight members, linear restraints or springs, nodal force and moment loads and explicitly empty pressure regions; an authored load/reference-state group includes resolved eigenloads and prescribed motions. Timoshenko documents, nonzero mill tolerance or corrosion allowance and other source families are declined by name. No code compliance or professional acceptance is produced, and actual numerical admission remains separate.
One resolved case per load case supplies each member's selected E/nu with derived G, actual/selected/installation temperatures and explicit expansion definition; each case is solved independently.

Thermal and fit reference strain compose as lambda_fit*lambda_thermal-1 and enter once as an axial eigenstrain; uniform member temperature only, no gradients, finite strain, inelasticity or fit-up joints.

Global rigid support translations/rotations are prescribed absolute boundary values through the partitioned solve; reactions come from the unreduced equations. Spring base motion, device preload/reference, inactive or locked supports are not provided.

Ordinary applied loads are exactly the case's declared source ledger with explicit factors; unreferenced stored primitives are excluded. Hydrostatic head, contents-weight state and per-case mass selection are not provided.
History is independent equilibrium only; no installation, contact, friction or predecessor history is represented.

Realized curved bends (curved_bend_macro_element with the user's bend radius and flexibility factor k, one k for both bending planes) are admitted under pressure: each owns the term K_b*u_free(eps_p) - c_b, with eps_p = (1-2nu)pAi/(E As) (the straight Lame mean Poisson term on the arc) and c_b its own end caps along the end tangents; on an arc N_w = N_el + pAi and S = N_el, and shear and moments are elastic. A region changes direction only at realized bends: a bend-end direction change up to alpha_tan = 1e-3 rad is carried exactly by the remainder pAi(t_in - t_out); a larger change (a mitre) and a straight-straight kink are refused. Geometry-only (chord) bends carry no pressure and are refused. On arcs the straight Lame hoop and radial values and the governing normal-stress maximum are withheld; the excluded effects above apply to every bend result.

Member actions, section actions, stresses and support reactions of a load case reported NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_CHECKS_PASSED are recovered at 128-bit precision from the formation check's corrected displacement and rounded once; they are not binary64 recomputations from the published displacements, from which they may differ by about 1e-12 of the body's action scale (at most about 6e-9 in the evaluation sets).

The recovery is checked against the formation check's re-formed system (stiffness and loads formed at 128-bit precision from the binary64 inputs). The published displacements are the solve's own, judged by the formation check's per-row rule; support reactions balance the re-formed loads, not the solve's binary64 load vector.

The circular normal-stress maximum bounds the supplied binary64 polynomial coefficient enclosures; solution error is separate, and incomplete coverage withholds the headline.

Every member section declares its corrosion allowance and the contract declares its shear model. This envelope publishes ordinary structural recovery. Timoshenko documents, nonzero mill tolerance or corrosion allowance and other source families are declined by name. No code compliance or professional acceptance is produced, and actual numerical admission remains separate.

Realized curved bends (curved_bend_macro_element with the user's bend radius and flexibility factor k, one k for both bending planes) are admitted under pressure: each owns the term K_b*u_free(eps_p) - c_b, with eps_p = (1-2nu)pAi/(E As) (the straight Lame mean Poisson term on the arc) and c_b its own end caps along the end tangents; on an arc N_w = N_el + pAi and S = N_el, and shear and moments are elastic. A region changes direction only at realized bends: a bend-end direction change up to alpha_tan = 1e-3 rad is carried exactly by the remainder pAi(t_in - t_out); a larger change (a mitre) and a straight-straight kink are refused. Geometry-only (chord) bends carry no pressure and are refused. On arcs the straight Lame hoop and radial values and the governing normal-stress maximum are withheld; the excluded effects above apply to every bend result.

limitations: 3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3 under pressure-2 semantics. Admitted families: small-displacement homogeneous-isotropic straight circular pipe members (shear deformation as the contract declares: euler_bernoulli, or timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1 with the energy-matched annular shear factor, whose nodal rotations are section rotations; G is derived from E/nu) and linear restraints or springs; realized curved bends are Euler-Bernoulli under either shear model and, with expansion joints authored as objective connectors, are admitted only as the bend and connector limitations state. Section bases: stiffness and pipe metal mass use the nominal wall; contents mass and pressure end-cap areas use the reduced bore; every stress row is published on the nominal section and on the reduced section (wall minus mill tolerance and corrosion allowance) and names its basis, and each basis has its own maximum and headline; no governing basis is chosen. Each basis's Lamé stresses are those of its own annulus, while the axial membrane stress divides the one wall force by that basis's area. Every other component, support, combination or equivalent-static family is refused by name (EXACT_PRESSURE_FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED) until a later contract revision admits it.

Pressure is a signed internal differential with zero external pressure increment, uniform within each explicit case-scoped collinear equal-bore region with explicit closure-transfer paths. A negative differential is admitted, but external-pressure stability and collapse are not assessed.
Not modelled: steady-flow momentum and transient pressure loads; bend opening under pressure (Bourdon effect); pressure stiffening of flexibility factors and stress intensification; ovalization.
Mechanical, pressure-eigen and cap-transfer contributions remain distinct; rounded cap/eigen ledgers are observational and do not replace source-grouped pressure assembly.
Structural line loads act as entered; contents density does not imply hydrostatic pressure head or a coupled static-fluid pressure/weight state.
Signed support actions are attributed only for admitted linear restraints and springs; ambiguous coincident rigid attribution is refused.
The circular normal-stress maximum bounds the supplied binary64 polynomial coefficient enclosures; solution error is separate, and incomplete coverage withholds the headline.

Every member section declares its corrosion allowance and the contract declares its shear model. This envelope publishes ordinary structural recovery. Retained-source recovery is available only for euler_bernoulli documents with zero mill tolerance and zero corrosion allowance, and only for straight members, linear restraints or springs, nodal force and moment loads and explicitly empty pressure regions; an authored load/reference-state group includes resolved eigenloads and prescribed motions. Timoshenko documents, nonzero mill tolerance or corrosion allowance and other source families are declined by name. No code compliance or professional acceptance is produced, and actual numerical admission remains separate.

Objective connectors (expansion joints, objective_connector 1.0.0): symmetric-midpoint, small-displacement, small-rotation linear elastic law with the authored 6x6 work matrix, frame, offsets and installed reference q_ref, replacing exactly one straight span (replaces_span); untied hardware only. A pressurized joint (constant_effective_area_reference_v1) is a coaxial edge of one equal-bore pressure region between straight members, with zero attachment offsets, and carries the dead pressure load p(Ae - Ai) at its attachments, Ae being the authored effective area; unequal bore or pressure, offset faces, joints at region terminals or beside realized arcs, and ties are refused. No finite rotation, follower or geometric stiffness, pressure stiffening, squirm or stability, tie, temperature law or stop is modelled; the replaced span carries no load, member result or self-weight. Connector actions are published as generalized and end-node elastic actions, with the joint pressure force pAe and the effective axial force published separately; they are outside the straight-member recovery coverage.

Member actions, section actions, stresses and support reactions of a load case reported NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_CHECKS_PASSED are recovered at 128-bit precision from the formation check's corrected displacement and rounded once; they are not binary64 recomputations from the published displacements, from which they may differ by about 1e-12 of the body's action scale (at most about 6e-9 in the evaluation sets).

The recovery is checked against the formation check's re-formed system (stiffness and loads formed at 128-bit precision from the binary64 inputs). The published displacements are the solve's own, judged by the formation check's per-row rule; support reactions balance the re-formed loads, not the solve's binary64 load vector.
